needed.evidence: Informal path and narrow sidewalk under 1m, people walking in the roadway
needed.suggestion: Install a continuous and usable sidewalk of at least 3 meters width along the left side to provide a safe pedestrian space.

needed.evidence: Obstruction on footway by parked vehicles, partly blocking access
needed.suggestion: Enforce parking restrictions and install adequate signage to ensure the right sidewalk remains clear and accessible for pedestrians.

needed.evidence: Uneven sidewalk sections causing potential tripping hazards
needed.suggestion: Repair and maintain the sidewalk to eliminate any uneven sections and ensure a smooth walking surface.

needed.evidence: No kerb ramps at the zebra crossing
needed.suggestion: Install kerb ramps at the zebra crossing to ensure easy and safe access for pedestrians, including those with disabilities.

needed.evidence: Marked crossing with potential visibility issues for vehicles
needed.suggestion: Upgrade the marked crossing to a signalised crossing or add high-visibility markings and audible signals to improve its safety and ensure drivers stop.

needed.evidence: Wide road with more than four lanes and no refuge on marked crossing
needed.suggestion: Add a central refuge island in the crossing to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians crossing the wide road.

needed.evidence: Urban road with only some street lights and several dark sections
needed.suggestion: Install additional street lights to ensure ample lighting along the entire road, reducing shadowing and improving visibility at night.
